founder.project_name: Fresco — the scribe for construction superintendents

context_fields.job: keep an accurate record of the day's work on site
context_fields.circumstance: the day's site walks are done and the photos and notes still have to go into the daily log
context_fields.segment: superintendents at US general contractors whose jobs run on Procore or ACC

founder.problem_seed: Construction superintendents spend up to 3 hours a day on documents — they take 30-200 photos a day on their site walks, then spend hours at the end of the day in the trailer uploading them to Procore or OneDrive and typing daily logs and punch lists, mostly for liability or a dispute with the owner; based on our weekends talking to superintendents on job sites in Napa, the South Bay and San Francisco.
founder.solution_seed: An AI scribe: during the site walk the superintendent takes short videos and talks over them, and Fresco turns them into notes with photos, assignees and due dates, texts the crew their action items and sends the notes to Procore or ACC in one click.
